events.title: Rhythm Hotel Wins "Excellence in Audio" at the Big Indie Pitch!
events.summary: Dear players, great news! At the 2026 Big Indie Pitch, Rhythm Hotel won the "Excellence in Audio" award! For a rhythm game, music is our beating heart. To receive this recognition, we're genuinely thrilled. Thank you to every players who played the demo, wishlisted, and shared feedback with us. And thank you to the organizers and the judges for their recognition.

Thank you to everyone who played the demo, wishlisted, and shared your feedback. This one's for you! The game is nearly complete and we're now in full optimization mode. Stay tuned! — SyncArc-Studio

events.title: "Rhythm Hotel" Wins Best Soundtrack Award
events.summary: At the recently concluded 17th Xiamen International Animation Festival's "Golden Dolphin Awards" ceremony, "Rhythm Hotel" won the Best Soundtrack Award and received a nomination for the Best Game Award. The "Cyber Sousa Awards" were established in 2008 and have since become one of the most authoritative and influential competitions in China's animation industry. This year's event attracted participants from over 50 countries and regions, with more than 3,000 animation and game works submitted.
